properties.title: NRC Report: Diethylenetriamine Tetramine near Monahan, TX
properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 1360633 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: FEDEX FREIGHT CHEMICAL MANAGEMENT
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1360633
Incident Time: 2023-02-22 18:30:00
Nearest City: Monahan, TX
Location: I-20 EXIT 71
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: DIETHYLENETRIAMINE TETRAMINE
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: FEDEX FREIGHT CHEMICAL MANAGEMENT
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 31.574469, -102.925451 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER IS REPORTING AN EXPLOSION THAT CAUSED A TRACTOR TRAILER FIRE. THE CALLER STATES THAT THERE WAS A DOUBLE LOAD TRACTOR TRAILER BEING TRANSPORTED, WHEN THERE WAS AN EXPLOSION THAT BLEW THE DOOR OPEN ON THE BACK OF THE SECOND (HAZMAT) TRAILER THAT CONTAINED TRIETHYLENE TETRAMINE (AMINES), POLYAMINES, DIETHYLENETRIAMINE TETRAMINE, (PHENOL, DIETHYLENETRIAMINE). THE EXPLOSION CAUSED A FIRE TO ERUPT ON THE SECOND TRAILER, THAT LEAD INTO THE FIRST TRAILER. THE FIRST TRAILER CONTAINED UNKNOWN NON-HAZARDOUS MATERIAL AND THE SECOND TRAILER CONTAINED 4 CORROSIVE HAZARDOUS MATERIALS, AND LITHIUM BATTERIES. THE DRIVER WAS ABLE TO DETACH THE TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK BEFORE THE TRAILERS CAUGHT FIRE. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE FIRE DEPARTMENT, POLICE DEPARTMENT AND TEXAS STATE TROOPERS HAVE CLOSED THE ROAD AND PLAN TO EXTINGUISH THE FIRE WITH UNKNOWN FIRE FIGHTING FOAM. THE CALLER ALSO STATES, THAT EITHER THE COUNTY OR THE STATE HAS ARRIVED WITH A "FRONT END LOADER" (CONSTRUCTION VEHICLE) AND PUSHED THE RESIDUAL BURNT MATERIAL INTO THE ROAD SIDE DITCH, WHILE THERE WERE TOW TRUCKS ON SCENE TO REMOVE THE BURNT TRAILERS. PERSONNEL FROM THE SRP ARE ENROUTE TO PICK UP THE DRIVER, AND WILL HAVE A SECOND DRIVER WITH THEM TO DRIVE THE TRACTOR TAILER TRUCK BACK TO THE FACILITY. IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE DRIVER WILL BE EVALUATED AT THIS TIME.

Report Description
***WEB REPORT***AT 0821U ON SUNDAY JANUARY 19, 2014 SECTOR SAN FRANCISCO COMMAND CENTER (SCC) RECEIVED NOTIFICATION OF A VEHICLE IN THE WATER IVO OF BIXBY CREEK NEAR BIG SUR, CA. THE VEHICLE IS REPORTED TO HAVE DRIVEN OFF THE BRIDGE AND INTO THE WATER. LOCAL AGENCIES CONTACTED STA MONTEREY REQUESTING ASSISTANCE. STA MONTEREY BRIEFED SCC. SCC DETERMINED THAT STA MONTEREY SMALL BOAT WOULD BE UNABLE TO ASSIST. LOCAL AGENCIES REQUESTED A HELICOPTER BUT AFTER FURTHER ASSESSMENT OF THE INCIDENT CONDITIONS IT WAS DETERMINED THAT A COAST GUARD HELICOPTER WAS NOT NEEDED. SCC REQUESTED THAT AUX MOBILE 15 BE DISPATCHED. IT WAS REPORTED TO SCC THAT AT LEAST ONE SURVIVOR WAS ON ROCKS AWAITING RESCUE WHILE THE OTHER PASSENGER IS DECEASED. SCC RECIEVED FROM AUX MOBILE UNIT THAT ARRIVED ON SCENE THAT THE VEHICLE IS A SEDAN AND DOES NOT APPREAR TO LEAKING ANY FUEL. CASE PENDS.

SCC REQUESTED THAT AUX MOBILE 15 BE DISPATCHED. IT WAS REPORTED TO SCC THAT AT LEAST ONE SURVIVOR WAS ON ROCKS AWAITING RESCUE WHILE THE OTHER PASSENGER IS DECEASED. SCC RECIEVED FROM AUX MOBILE UNIT THAT ARRIVED ON SCENE THAT THE VEHICLE IS A SEDAN AND DOES NOT APPREAR TO LEAKING ANY FUEL. CASE PENDS.
